import re,glob,collections
rows=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.txt')):
    t=open(f).read()
    for pg in re.split(r'=== page \d+\n',t)[2:]:
        m=re.search(r'finds the following violation\(s\):\s*(.*?)\n\s*\n',pg,re.S)
        if not m: print('NOCITE',f,pg[:200]);continue
        cite=m.group(1).strip()
        r=re.search(r'recommends the following civil penalty:(.*?)Abstentions',pg,re.S)
        rec=r.group(1) if r else ''
        a=re.search(r'\$+\s*([\d,\s]*\d)',rec)
        amt=int(re.sub(r'[,\s]','',a.group(1))) if a else 0
        c=re.sub(r'^IC\s*8-1-26-','',cite)
        c=re.sub(r'\([A-Za-z][A-Za-z-]+\)','',c).strip()
        rows.append((f,c,amt,cite,rec.strip()))
for k in ['16(h)','20(a)(2)']:
    v=[x[2] for x in rows if x[1]==k and x[2]>0]
    print(k,len(v),sum(v)/len(v),sum(1 for x in rows if x[1]==k))
print(collections.Counter(x[1] for x in rows))
E
